title: Part Sale Matrix column reads On once a matrix has its own Part Sale side
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A, with Separate Part Sale pricing off.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click the Part Sale Matrix tab.
  4. Turn on Separate Part Sale pricing.
  5. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A's Part Sale Matrix reads Off.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The tab shows the Separate Part Sale pricing switch, off.

Step 4:

  • The switch is on and the Part Sale grid shows.

Step 5:

  • Matrix A's Part Sale Matrix now reads On.
  • Its Work Order Matrix still shows Default's rules in short.
